purpose: The build-time negative image secret-flow (planning/mvp-m2-plan.md, Scenarios and the harness, Q10): anchor with host_t given read map on secret_t throughout, so that only the secret's flow is wrong: the policy gains allow host_t secret_t : memory { read map };, the need sets that permission set, and the manifest gives G0's root the secret page's read leaf. A3 fails: host_t maps secret_t, the protected domain's private type (I1), and secret_t is storage that two domain types hold with no channel rule. Every other analysis passes, A6 included: the secret page has no writer, so it adds no pair to F, and Instance 3 already declares both directions between host_t and prot_t, so F+ = D+ still holds. The plan's "A6 and A3 refuse" (Scenarios and the harness, the negative images' table) is therefore an erratum: by security model v1's definition of A6 (planning/security-model-v1.md, Part 3), A3 alone refuses it; neither analysis is changed to make A6 fire. tools/gen-scenario.py writes no header, so no image exists. make -C mvp policy-negatives runs it with tools/policy-check.py --negative secret-flow, which passes only if the check fails exactly as declared below.
name: secret-flow

edits: allow host_t secret_t : memory { read map };
